answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 487 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vertex. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the cedar queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 315 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
